limits: Both packages are development snapshots. No independently released-package compatibility is claimed.
Acceptance is bound to the retained gen14-session package seal, JavaScript graph and native bytes. Pending stage-marker and late integration source changes are not represented.
Package versions and revision labels do not establish immutable source-commit provenance. Recorded hashes identify the observed implementations.
Windows SendInput was used. This is not human physical-key evidence.
The game was x64. x86 payload integrity is package evidence, not x86 game acceptance.
OS module snapshots plus module-file hashes identify observed mapped modules, not remote-memory bytes or a historical injection count.
Retired add-on code remained mapped in the original game; scene disappearance and survivor rendering/input establish isolation. Only the fresh relaunch excludes the retired add-on.
Initial late-member target authentication remains in target-authenticated events and controller assertions. The final survivor state contains the relaunched target identity.
Embedded finalStates and raw state files represent different capture times; raw snapshots may contain later target-disconnected and exit-command updates from cleanup.
No overall feature/backend matrix completion, current working-tree source equivalence, or native fault containment is claimed.
Raw build artifacts retain original absolute paths. This portable audit uses repository-relative artifact paths and exact raw-file SHA-256 values.
